<thought>To locate a template for the carbonyl‑ene cyclization, I will search the catalog using the forward‑reaction criteria: the reaction breaks a ketone and a C=C double bond, and forms an aliphatic hydroxyl and a new C‑C single bond. This should return a suitable single‑step retrosynthetic template.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "C=C(c1ccccc1)C1CCC(C(F)(F)F)C1O",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "C-C double bonds"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["aliphatic hydroxyls", "C-C single bonds"],
  "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
